description: ADOC Toolkit API Reference for GET endpoints

/catalog-server/api/assets.description: Retrieve an asset by its unique identifier (UID).

uid.description: A unique identifier (UID) for the asset.

/catalog-server/api/assets/discover.description: Retrieve a list of assets based on specified query parameters

parents.description: Whether to include parent assets in the response.

size.description: The number of assets to include per page.

profiled_assets.description: Whether to include profiled assets in the response.

watchers.description: Whether to include watchers in the response.

asset_type_ids.description: Comma-separated list of asset type IDs.

/catalog-server/api/assets/list/facets.description: Retrieve a list of facets for assets.

parents.description: Whether to include parent assets in the response.

asset_type_ids.description: Comma-separated list of asset type IDs.

size.description: The number of assets to include per page.

profiled_assets.description: Whether to include profiled assets in the response.

watchers.description: Whether to include watchers in the response.

/catalog-server/api/asset-types.description: Retrieve a list of asset types.

size.description: The number of assets to include per page.

assetName.description: The name of the asset to profile.

/catalog-server/api/assets/reference-ass.description: Retrieve a list of jobs for reference assets.

size.description: The number of assets to include per page.

/catalog-server/api/assets/reference-ass.description: Retrieve a list of reference assets.

analyticsPipelineId.description: The ID of the analytics pipeline.

/catalog-server/api/source-types.description: Retrieve a list of source types.

/catalog-server/api/data-sources.description: Retrieve a list of data sources.

/catalog-server/api/assemblies/auto-prof.description: Retrieve a list of auto-profile configurations.

/catalog-server/api/connection-types.description: Retrieve a list of connection types.

/catalog-server/api/analytics-pipelines.description: Retrieve a list of analytics pipelines.

includeTags.description: Whether to include tags in the response.

search_str.description: The search string to filter the rules.

onlyActive.description: Whether to only include active rules.

filename.description: The filename to export the rules to.

releaseVersion.description: The release version to export the rules to.

rules_page_size.description: The number of rules to include per page.

size.description: The number of rules to include per page.

enabled.description: Whether to only include enabled rules.

/catalog-server/api/rules/executions.description: Retrieve a list of rule executions.

size.description: The number of rule executions to include per page.

executionStatus.description: The status of the rule execution.

resultStatus.description: The status of the rule execution result.

ruleId.description: The ID of the rule to retrieve executions for.

/catalog-server/api/rules/grouped-execut.description: Retrieve a list of grouped rule executions.

size.description: The number of rule executions to include per page.

startedAfter.description: The date and time to filter the rule executions by.

finishedBefore.description: The date and time to filter the rule executions by.

/catalog-server/api/rules/data-quality.description: Retrieve a list of data quality rules.

size.description: The number of data quality rules to include per page.

ruleStatus.description: The status of the data quality rule.

enabled.description: Whether to only include enabled rules.
